notes.title: Update 2.8888
notes.content: [p]   Hello, friends! For some unknown reason, a bug with obtaining the "Rocketeer" achievement appeared again. A thousand apologies, I fixed and fixed everything!!! And as for the "Dr. Mazai" achievement, everything works there, you just need to go back a little bit in the scene with the bus hijacking and meet Mazay from the tardis))   [/p][p]    By the way, The Last Shot: Arcade is coming out on June 24, 2025!!![/p][p][/p][p] Best regards, Rumata[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.08
notes.content:
Hello everyone, dear friends!!! In update 2.08, some processes related to animations (inverse kinematics) were optimized, and minor bugs were also fixed, including the inability to obtain the “Rocketman” achievement.
   Enjoy the game and have a good mood everyone!!!

Best regards, Rumata

notes.title: Update 2.00
notes.content:
Hello friends !!!

The game update v.2.00 is now live,  we have fixed bugs, added localization and several Easter eggs !

Thank you for your ongoing support.

Best regards, Rumata

notes.title: MANY GREAT NEWS
notes.content:
Hello friends,

We're excited to share some fantastic news with you!

Our latest game update is now live, addressing bugs you've reported and incorporating improvements based on your feedback. We're also thrilled to announce that the game is now fully compatible with Steamdeck, backed by Steam's green badge of approval. As a token of our appreciation, we've made a few small enhancements to the game and significantly reduced the price by 50%!

Thank you for your ongoing support.

Best regards, Rumata
